title: Sriram Krishnan Raises $500M Fund for Later Stage AI
summary:
The top artificial intelligence adviser to the Trump administration has returned to the private sector to launch a new venture capital firm. Sriram Krishnan is raising approximately $500 million for a fund targeting later stage AI companies after leaving his government role in June.

Krishnan, a former general partner at a16z, is the latest of several former Trump officials to rejoin the venture world or join firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic. He enters a crowded field of investors currently seeking mature artificial intelligence startups to add to their portfolios.
